segments.he: נִשְׁתַּטֵּית וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַבִּי יִצְחָק: דְּבַר תּוֹרָה שׁוֹטָה מִתְגָּרֶשֶׁת, מִידֵּי דְּהָוֵה אַפִּקַּחַת בְּעַל כׇּרְחָהּ. וּמָה טַעַם אָמְרוּ אֵינָהּ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת? שֶׁלֹּא יִנְהֲגוּ בָּהּ מִנְהַג הֶפְקֵר.
segments.en: § The mishna taught that one whose wife «became imbecilic» may not divorce her. «Rabbi Yitzḥak said: By Torah law, an imbecilic woman may be divorced, just as it is» in the analogous case of «a» halakhically «competent woman» who was divorced «against her will.» Since there is no need for a woman to agree to receive a bill of divorce, an imbecile’s lack of sound mind does not prevent her from being divorced. «And» if so, «what is» the «reason» that the Sages «said» that an imbecilic woman «may not be divorced?» The reason is so «that» people «should not treat her in the manner of ownerless» property. Since she is not of sound mind and has no husband to protect her, there is a concern that people might treat her in a disrespectful fashion.
